title: Logical Sequence of Words
shortDescription: Arrange given words in a meaningful order: process, size, time, hierarchy and dictionary order.
genZNote: Arrange the words the way life arranges them — seed before tree, FIR before verdict. Logic, not vocabulary.

sections.heading: Dictionary Order Tips
sections.body: Compare letters one at a time from the left; a shorter word precedes when it is a prefix (e.g. "Act" before "Action"). For words with the same first letter use the second letter, and so on.

quickRevision.oneLineDefinition: Logical sequence of words requires ordering items by a natural, temporal, hierarchical or alphabetical basis.
keyFacts: Alphabet order compares left to right.
Process order starts with the origin.

highYieldFacts: Prefix words come first in a dictionary.
commonTraps: Do not rely on first impression; check each pair.
